story.title: Best jokes in the world
paragraphs_en: Four aliens came to earth in human forms so no one can make out they are aliens. Anyway, let's get to the point why did the 4 aliens come to earth? The 4 aliens came to earth to learn English. The 1st alien learned "we did it ", the 2nd alien learned " he stole my candy ", the 3rd alien learned "forks and knives", the 4th alien learned "yippie". One day they killed a person the police officer

asked the 1st alien did you kill him the 1st alien said we did it then the police officer asked the 2nd alien why did you kill him the 2nd alien said he stole my candy, after that he asked the 3rd alien how did you kill him "forks and knives replied the 3rd alien, at last, the police officer said you are going to jail then yippie yippie yippie yippie!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! shouted the 4th alien.

There were 2 brothers named Mad and Brain. Brain was stuck in the washroom so Mad went to the police officer and Mad said to the police officer my brother is stuck in the washroom the police officer replied is that a case yes sir replied Mad. T he police officer said are you mad yes sir how do you know sir replied Mad, the police officer asked Mad where is your Brain dude stuck in
in the washroom, sir replied Mad. You are going to jail!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! said the police officer.

Once there was a person called Suppandi one day Suppandis brother got fever so Suppandi went to the doctor, and the doctor said Suppandi give 3 spoons of this medicine to your brother Suppandi replied "but sir I only have 2 spoons in my house"
